q-182409.problem:
Find the missing values in the following truth table:

| $\,A\,$ | $\,B\,$ | $\,(A∧B)∧(A∨B)\,$ |
| --- | --- | --- |
| $\text{T}$ | $\text{T}$ | {{field-1}} |
| $\text{T}$ | $\text{F}$ | {{field-2}} |
| $\text{F}$ | $\text{T}$ | {{field-3}} |
| $\text{F}$ | $\text{F}$ | {{field-4}} |
q-182409.worked_solution:
First, we complete a truth table for the first part in parentheses, $A∧B.$ The statement $A∧B$ is true if both $A$ and $B$ are true.

| $\,A\,$ | $\,B\,$ | $\,A∧B\,$ |
| --- | --- | --- |
| $\text{T}$ | $\text{T}$ | $\text{T}$ |
| $\text{T}$ | $\text{F}$ | $\text{F}$ |
| $\text{F}$ | $\text{T}$ | $\text{F}$ |
| $\text{F}$ | $\text{F}$ | $\text{F}$ |

Next, we append the truth table for the second part in parentheses, $A∨B.$ The statement $A∨B$ is true if either $A$ is true, $B$ is true, or both $A$ and $B$ are true. 

| $\,A\,$ | $\,B\,$ | $\,A∧B\,$ | $\,A∨B\,$ |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| $\text{T}$ | $\text{T}$ | $\text{T}$ | $\text{T}$ |
| $\text{T}$ | $\text{F}$ | $\text{F}$ | $\text{T}$ |
| $\text{F}$ | $\text{T}$ | $\text{F}$ | $\text{T}$ |
| $\text{F}$ | $\text{F}$ | $\text{F}$ | $\text{F}$ |

Finally, we look at the column $(A∧B)$ and the column $(A∨B)$ to complete the column $(A∧B)∧(A∨B).$ The statement $(A∧B)∧(A∨B)$ is true if both $(A∧B)$ and $(A∨B)$ are true. 

The completed truth table is shown below:

| $\,A\,$ | $\,B\,$ | $\,A∧B\,$ | $\,A∨B\,$ | $\,(A∧B)∧(A∨B)\,$ |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| $\text{T}$ | $\text{T}$ | $\text{T}$ | $\text{T}$ | $\text{T}$ |
| $\text{T}$ | $\text{F}$ | $\text{F}$ | $\text{T}$ | $\text{F}$ |
| $\text{F}$ | $\text{T}$ | $\text{F}$ | $\text{T}$ | $\text{F}$ |
| $\text{F}$ | $\text{F}$ | $\text{F}$ | $\text{F}$ | $\text{F}$ |
